name: Panel MEP Penetration
description: Defines MEP service penetrations for a panel component's 'features' input. Each layer gets its own outline: the core outline is framed, and every layer's sheathing is trimmed by its own outline. Outlines are moved onto their layer's outer face.

inputParameters.name: outline_core
inputParameters.description: Closed outlines of the penetrations through the core layer. These define the surround framing.

inputParameters.name: outline_interior
inputParameters.description: (Optional) Closed outlines for the interior layer, matched to outline_core by index. Defaults to the core outline.

inputParameters.name: outline_exterior
inputParameters.description: (Optional) Closed outlines for the exterior layer, matched to outline_core by index. Defaults to the core outline.

inputParameters.name: detail_set
inputParameters.description: (Optional) A detail set (CT: Detail Agent Set) that builds these features, in place of the populator's default for this feature type.

outputParameters.name: features
outputParameters.description: Panel feature definitions. Connect to a panel component's 'features' input; each panel adds the ones that lie on it.
